entities.summary: Jack Lawless is an American musician. He was the drummer for the band DNCE before their second hiatus in 2024 and currently drummer for band Ocean Grove. He is the live drummer for the pop rock group Jonas Brothers. He grew up in Middletown Township, New Jersey, part of Monmouth County.
